source: Owner direct chat requesting a full technical destruction audit after repeated FPS regression

delivery: Docs/Tasks/DestructionAudit01.md and evidence under Saved/DestructionAudit01; local task-scoped documentation commit. Future production execution uses the standing Multica route and task-scoped review.
